dsh-code-check 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。自动类型检查诊断：模型编辑/创建 TS 文件后后台防抖运行 `tsc --noEmit`，经 `code_check` 工具按文件分组汇报错误（行列号 + 严重级别 + TS 错误码），形成「改 → 查 → 修」闭环。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-596e2d324da1b60a9e82.html
posts.en:
dsh-code-check is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Automatic type-check diagnostics: after the model edits or creates TS files, runs `tsc --noEmit` in the background (debounced per project) and reports errors via the `code_check` tool — grouped by file with line/column, severity and TS error codes, closing the "edit → check → fix" loop.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-596e2d324da1b60a9e82.html
